comment: The demo's nine scenes (make demo). caption: shown on screen during the recording; spoken: what the voice says, for demo.srt. A voice clip line-<n>.wav per scene sets how long that scene lasts; without one, seconds is used.

lines.caption: The funder dashboard: where people handle the loans automation couldn’t fund
lines.spoken: This is the funder dashboard: the place where people handle the loans our automation couldn't fund on its own.

lines.caption: Sign in and land on your work: assigned to you, ready to take, and what’s missing
lines.spoken: When I sign in, I land on my work: the deals assigned to me, and the ones ready for me to take, each with what's missing.

lines.caption: Every deal is routed to the right specialist. One click opens it.
lines.spoken: Every deal is routed to the right specialist, so I only see my kind of work. One click opens it.

lines.caption: What’s been done: every check, and exactly why it passed or failed
lines.spoken: Right away I can see what's been done: every check, and exactly why it passed or failed. Here the TILA math is off by ten dollars.

lines.caption: Passed checks show their evidence too; the activity shows who did what
lines.spoken: Every passed check shows its evidence too, and the activity shows who did what.

lines.caption: The assistant summarizes the deal, with a local AI model on this laptop
lines.spoken: If I want the short version, the assistant summarizes the deal, using a local AI model on my laptop.

lines.caption: The supervisor asks the assistant who should take each unassigned deal, and why
lines.spoken: My supervisor can ask the assistant who should take each unassigned deal. It checks the routing rules and each person's workload, and explains every pick.

lines.caption: Nothing is assigned until the supervisor confirms, one deal at a time
lines.spoken: Nothing happens until the supervisor confirms, one deal at a time.

lines.caption: Code builds every screen and makes every change. The AI only explains and suggests.
lines.spoken: Code builds every screen and makes every change. The AI only explains and suggests.
